select_device.title: Select a DJI Power device
select_device.description: Select a currently advertising DJI Power device. The BLE address and model code are read automatically from Home Assistant Bluetooth discovery.

auth_method.title: Obtain the local BLE pair key
auth_method.description: Choose how to obtain the per-device 32-character HEX pair key. Account and member-token methods use DJI cloud only during setup; normal operation remains local BLE.

menu_options.manual: Enter a known pair key manually

manual.title: Enter the local BLE pair key
manual.description: Enter the 32-character hexadecimal pair key for the selected DJI Power device.

token.title: Use a DJI member token
token.description: The token is used once to read pair_info.pair_key from the devices registered to the DJI account. It is not saved in the config entry.

account.title: Sign in to DJI (experimental)
account.description: DJI Home uses private account APIs that may change. The email address, password, CAPTCHA data, and resulting member token are kept only during setup and are not saved.

captcha.title: DJI image CAPTCHA
captcha.description:
Enter the characters shown below.

![DJI CAPTCHA]({image})

two_factor.title: DJI verification code
two_factor.description: Enter the email or two-step verification code requested by DJI. This private flow is experimental.

cloud_device.title: Select the registered DJI device
cloud_device.description: Select the cloud device that corresponds to the BLE device selected earlier.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate DJI Power Bluetooth
reauth_confirm.description: The saved local pair key appears to be invalid. Enter a new 32-character HEX key.

error.invalid_key: The local pair key must be 32 hexadecimal characters.
error.cloud_lookup_failed: Could not retrieve the DJI device list. The private DJI API may have changed or the token may be invalid.
error.no_cloud_devices: No registered DJI device with a local BLE pair key was found.
error.rate_limited: DJI temporarily rate-limited verification attempts. Try again later.

abort.already_configured: This DJI Power device is already configured.
abort.no_devices_found: No unconfigured, connectable DJI Power advertisement was found. Disconnect DJI Home from the device and try again.
abort.device_disappeared: The selected DJI Power device is no longer advertising.
abort.not_supported: The Bluetooth advertisement is not a supported DJI Power device.
abort.no_cloud_devices: No DJI cloud device with a pair key was found.
abort.invalid_pair_key_from_cloud: DJI cloud returned an invalid pair key.
abort.reauth_successful: The DJI Power pair key was updated.

init.title: DJI Power Bluetooth options
init.description: Control how often the latest BLE telemetry is published to Home Assistant. BLE notifications are still received and parsed at their native cadence.

start_protocol_capture.name: Start protocol capture
start_protocol_capture.description: Capture a bounded set of non-authentication DJI Power protocol payloads in memory. Download integration diagnostics after reproducing the condition.

device_id.name: DJI Power device
device_id.description: The physical DJI Power device to capture.

max_frames.name: Maximum frames
max_frames.description: Stop after this many safe protocol frames.

set_scheduled_energy_settings.name: Set scheduled energy settings
set_scheduled_energy_settings.description: Update one or more known 0x1018 scheduled-energy fields in a single BLE read-modify-write transaction. Unspecified fields are preserved.

device_id.name: DJI Power device
device_id.description: The physical DJI Power device to configure.

energy_optimization_mode.name: Energy optimization mode
energy_optimization_mode.description: Set Disabled or Scheduled periods. Scheduled-only fields require the resulting mode to be scheduled.

peak_discharging.name: Peak discharging
peak_discharging.description: Enable or disable discharging during peak tariff periods.

off_peak_charging.name: Off-peak charging
off_peak_charging.description: Enable or disable charging during off-peak tariff periods.

off_peak_charging_power.name: Off-peak charging power
off_peak_charging_power.description: Set the off-peak AC charging power in watts. The device-specific range and step are validated before writing.

set_tariff_schedule.name: Set tariff schedule
set_tariff_schedule.description: Replace the device's complete electricity tariff schedule using either a preset or a list of non-overlapping tariff periods.

device_id.name: DJI Power device
device_id.description: The physical DJI Power device to configure.

preset.name: Preset
preset.description: Replace the complete schedule with a verified all-day peak or all-day off-peak preset. Do not specify periods at the same time.

periods.name: Tariff periods
periods.description: Replace the complete schedule with these tariff periods. Weekdays apply to the start day; an end time earlier than the start time crosses midnight. Do not specify a preset at the same time.
